up: Retrieve IC50 activity data for compounds tested against the human protein target 'Prostaglandin G/H synthase 2' (CHEMBL230). Return the compound preferred name, compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES structure, IC50 standard value, IC50 standard units, assay description, assay ChEMBL ID, publication DOI, publication PubMed ID, publication year, and document ChEMBL ID. Filter activities by standard_type 'IC50'.
sql: SELECT md.pref_name, md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, ass.description AS assay_description, ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, d.doi, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.chembl_id AS doc_chembl_id FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL230' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
